configure optimization defaults

Source: R/utils_perf_optim.R
set_perf_optim_opts.Rd

configure optimization defaults

Usage

set_perf_optim_opts(v2 = TRUE)
set_perf_optim_opts(offset_as_vec = TRUE, do_parallel = 8L, delay_mu = TRUE, use_nr_overdisp_impl = TRUE)

get_perf_optim_opts()

Arguments

v2

boolean, coarse grained flag to enable all implemented optimizations.

calling set_perf_optim_opts(v2 = TRUE) is equivalent to:

set_perf_optim_opts(offset_as_vec = TRUE, do_parallel = parallel::detectCores(), delay_mu = TRUE, use_nr_overdisp_impl = TRUE)

offset_as_vec

boolean, enables representing the model offsets as a per-gene vector when they do not vary across any one observation

do_parallel

integer, sets level of parallelization (see details)

delay_mu

boolean, enables representing Mu via a thunk interface instead of eagerly computing a dense representation

use_nr_overdisp_impl

boolean, enables using an alternate overdispersion estimation method implemented in C++

Value

  • set_perf_optim_opts returns NULL

  • get_perf_optim_opts returns the currently configured list of optimization-relevant defaults

Details

setting do_parallel to 0 disables parallelism entirely, while setting it to 1 uses the parallelism code path but does not actually use more than one thread (e.g. this is only useful for testing).

currently, the following steps support parallelization:

  • beta estimation

  • overdispersion estimation, but only when use_nr_overdisp_impl is TRUE
